contentText: The United States has lost its long-held status of having eradicated measles as cases of the dangerous and highly contagious virus soar around the country. It follows accusations by medical experts that US President Donald Trump and his health secretary, noted vaccine skeptic Robert F. Kennedy Jr, have fanned distrust in vaccinations, leading to an decline on the number of children getting inoculated against the disease.
